items.detailEn:
Material: virgin wood pulp, 2-ply / 3-ply, soft & skin-friendly, strong when wet.\n
Sizes: 100/120/200 sheets, box / soft pack / plastic pack, custom sizes available.\n
Customization: logo printing on box, Pantone colors, free layout design, pre-production samples.\n
Applications: hotel rooms, restaurants, offices, reception desks, 4S stores.\n
Packing: 5-ply corrugated export cartons, pallet packing available.
items.enDesc: 5-ply virgin wood pulp;soft & skin-friendly, strong when wet；suitable for use in hotels, restaurants, and offices.
items.zhDesc: 5层原生木浆，纸质柔韧亲肤，湿水不易破，酒店、餐饮、办公适用。
items.detailZh:
【材质】5层原生木浆，纸质柔韧亲肤，湿水不易破。\n
【规格】常见 100抽/120抽/200抽，盒装 / 软包 / 塑料软抽多形式，可按要求定制尺寸与抽数。\n
【定制】支持盒面 LOGO 印刷、专色定制，提供设计稿排版服务，打样确认后量产。\n
【适用场景】酒店客房、餐饮包厢、办公场所、企业前台、4S 店等商务场景。\n
【包装】外箱五层瓦楞，支持托盘打包，出口标准包装。

items.detailEn:
Material: virgin / recycled pulp, 2-ply / 3-ply, 15-25gsm customizable.
Sizes: 80g-180g per roll, hotel & commercial sizes in stock.
Customization: individual wrap printing, embossing, perforation spacing, OEM available.
Applications: hotel rooms, malls, offices, schools, hospitals, property management.
MOQ: mixed batches accepted, quote by specification.
items.enDesc: For hotel rooms & malls. Customizable weight & ply, individually wrapped.
items.zhDesc: 酒店客房、商场卫生间适用，可定制克重与层数，独立包装。
items.detailZh:
【材质】原生木浆 / 再生浆可选，2 层 / 3 层，克重 15-25g 可定制。
【规格】80g-180g/卷常规规格，酒店小卷、商用中卷均有现货模具。
【定制】支持独立膜包装印刷、压花、打孔间距调整，可贴牌 OEM。
【适用场景】酒店客房、商场写字楼卫生间、学校、医院、物业。
【起订量】支持混批，具体按规格询价。

items.detailEn:
Material: virgin pulp jumbo roll, 2-ply, 500g-800g per roll.
Features: high capacity, longer service time, fewer replacements for high-traffic areas.
Customization: weight, ply, core size, logo printing available.
Applications: airports, stations, malls, offices, factories, public restrooms.
Note: requires a jumbo roll dispenser; matching dispensers available.
items.enDesc: For public restrooms, high capacity & durable, OEM processing supported.
items.zhDesc: 公共场所卫生间专用，大容量更耐用，支持 OEM 贴牌加工。
items.detailZh:
【材质】原生木浆大盘纸，2 层加厚，单卷 500g-800g 可选。
【特点】大容量设计，单卷使用时间长，减少更换频率，适合高人流量场所。
【定制】支持克重、层数、纸管规格定制，可印 LOGO。
【适用场景】机场车站、商场、写字楼、工厂、景区公共卫生间。
【提示】需搭配大盘纸专用纸架使用，可提供配套采购。

items.detailEn:

Customization: bag printing, logo embossing, size recommendation by scenario.
Applications: washrooms, restaurant kitchens, workshops, laboratories.
Packing: 20 packs/carton standard, adjustable.
items.enDesc: For kitchens & washrooms, strong absorption, interfold/multifold options.
items.zhDesc: 厨房、洗手间通用，吸水性强，抽取式/折叠式多规格。
items.detailZh:
【材质】原生木浆，高克重，吸水性强，擦拭不易掉屑。
【规格】抽取式（N/Z 折）/ 折叠式多规格，单层 / 双层可选。

items.detailEn:
Scope: one-stop service from design, plate making, production to export logistics.
Customizable: gsm, ply, size, sheet count, packaging, logo printing, embossing.
Certification: ISO9001 production management; compliant with GB/T 20808 etc.
Process: inquiry → quotation → sampling → production → QC & delivery, dedicated follow-up.
MOQ: varies by category, trial orders accepted; factory visits welcome.
items.enDesc: Custom packaging, weight & size under your brand — design to delivery, one stop.
items.zhDesc: 按您的品牌定制包装、克重、尺寸，提供从设计到出货一站式服务。
items.detailZh:
【服务范围】从产品设计、包装制版、生产到出口物流一站式服务。
【定制内容】克重、层数、尺寸、抽数、包装形式、LOGO 印刷、压花工艺均可定制。
【资质】生产流程通过 ISO9001 质量管理，产品符合 GB/T 20808 等相关标准。
【流程】沟通需求 → 报价 → 打样确认 → 签约生产 → 质检出货，专人全程跟进。
【起订量】各品类 MOQ 不同，支持小批量试单，欢迎来厂考察。

items.enDesc: Napkins, serviettes & tray mats combo supply to elevate your brand.
